title: How many of 400 proactive service transformer replacements each of a California utility's twelve districts gets in 2027, in proportion to its forecast transformers at risk of summer overload, when a plug-in vehicle on the default rate adds most of its charger's draw to a small transformer's recorded peak
subdomain: load-forecasting (each service transformer's summer 2027 4 to 9 pm peak forecast from its own recorded summer peaks and the plug-in vehicles registered at its service points on the record date, each vehicle taken at the rise in recorded peak it brings by rate schedule)
prompt_shape: an allocation of 400 replacements over twelve districts with each district's forecast at-risk count and Foothill's figure on its own, the 2025-26 pilot's replacements, kVA added and cost per replacement in its three districts, each district's summer 2026 failure customer-hours and customers out more than eight hours, and a chart of the customer-hours
